title: VAULTJob
description: Standardized contract for VAULT pipeline jobs and worker results.

job_id.description: Unique identifier of the pipeline job

status.description: Truthful state of the job execution

config_hash.description: SHA-256 digest of normalized stage configuration parameters

input_artifact_ids.description: Manifest digests or identifiers of input artifacts consumed

output_artifact_ids.description: Manifest digests or identifiers of output artifacts produced

metrics.description: Verified numerical evaluation or loss metrics produced by this stage

reason.description: Human-readable explanation of failure, quarantine, or skip

worker_id.description: Identifier of the worker host or GPU process
